script.analysis: All 19,092 stored characters read in two contiguous ranges with canonical hash match. Hook: two versions of you at 40; subscribe/like CTA. 40 as financial halftime (life expectancy ~80); disaster-vs-order portraits. Nine goals: (1) define ideal lifestyle and hedonic adaptation, (2) zero debt except mortgage with $20K card-minimum example, (3) 800+ credit score with $500K mortgage 3% vs 4% example, (4) 6-month emergency fund "in boring savings earning nothing", (5) 5x annual expenses invested (coast FIRE, $500K -> $3M+ in 25 years at 8%), (6) career capital, (7) age-appropriate fitness, (8) term life (10-12x expenses) and basic estate plan, (9) 70/40 rule for parent money talks; brief close. Checklist structure with clear signposting, practical and mostly mainstream advice; some absolutes and nominal-return framing. ASR not audio-verified.

claim_audit: 0:9600 $20,000 at 18% on minimum payments: with 1%-plus-interest minimums ~30 years and ~$29,000 interest; with 2% minimums ~54 years and ~$57,000 interest - "over 30 years and more than $40,000" is within the formula-dependent range. $500,000 mortgage at 3% vs 4% over 30 years: $2,108 vs $2,387/month, ~$100,460 total difference - correct, though 3-4% rates were not available in Jan 2026 and a 650-vs-800 score gap is not always a full point. "800 or higher non-negotiable" overstates: best mortgage pricing tiers typically begin around 760-780.

9600:19092 Emergency cash "earns basically nothing" ignores ~4% high-yield accounts available in 2025-2026. $500,000 at 8% for 25 years = ~$3.42M, correct nominally; but 5x expenses growing at a ~5% real return reaches only ~17x expenses in today's dollars by 65, short of the 25x (4% rule) target, so "will likely retire comfortably" relies on nominal figures and ignores inflation. Term life 10-12x annual expenses = $600K-$720K for $60K expenses, correct arithmetic (many rules use income, not expenses); low cost for healthy 35-year-olds broadly accurate. "40/70 rule" is a real caregiving-conversation heuristic. Life expectancy ~80 approximately correct for US.
